description: This file contains socket-related utility functions for operations such as converting interface names to addresses, parsing ports, obtaining socket endpoints, and converting socket addresses to string representations. It appears to be a source file for managing socket communication and address manipulations within a larger software project.

methods.name: int rtSocket_IsNumeric(char const * s)
methods.description: Checks if the provided string consists only of digits or periods, indicating it might be a numeric IP address.

methods.name: rtError rtSocket_InterfaceNameToAddress(char const * s,char * t,int n)
methods.description: Converts a network interface name to its associated IPv4 address.

methods.name: rtError rtSocketStorage_ParsePort(char const * s,uint16_t * port)
methods.description: Parses a port number from a string containing an IP address and port, separated by a colon.

methods.name: rtError rtSocketStorage_GetLength(struct sockaddr_storage * endpoint,socklen_t * len)
methods.description: Determines the appropriate length of a socket address structure based on its family (IPv4, IPv6, Unix).

methods.name: rtError rtSocketStorage_ToString(struct sockaddr_storage * ss,char * buff,int n,uint16_t * port)
methods.description: Converts a socket address stored in 'sockaddr_storage' into a human-readable string, optionally extracting the port.

methods.name: rtError rtSocket_GetLocalEndpoint(int fd,struct sockaddr_storage * endpoint)
methods.description: Retrieves the local socket endpoint (address and port) for a given socket descriptor.

methods.name: rtError rtSocketStorage_FromString(struct sockaddr_storage * ss,char const * addr)
methods.description: Parses a string representation of an address (including 'unix://', 'tcp://') into a sockaddr_storage structure.

methods.name: rtError rtSocketAddrStorage_GetLength(struct sockaddr_storage * ss,socklen_t * len)
methods.description: Determines the size of the sockaddr_storage based on its address family.

ctags.name: rtSocketStorage_ToString
ctags.pattern: /^rtSocketStorage_ToString(struct sockaddr_storage* ss, char* buff, int n, uint16_t* port)$/

ctags.name: rtSocket_InterfaceNameToAddress
ctags.pattern: /^rtSocket_InterfaceNameToAddress(char const* s, char* t, int n)$/
